caption: A ball rolls through the shadow of a signpost on a sunny pavement, and the post's shadow slides over the ball as it passes.

sa.check: A ball rolls along a pavement.
It passes through the shadow of a signpost.
The post's shadow slides over the ball as it passes.

pc.expect: The post's shadow appears on the ball's surface while the ball is inside it and slides off as the ball leaves.
pc.fail: The ball stays fully lit inside the post's shadow; or the dark band stays on the ball after it has passed; or the band appears before the ball reaches the shadow.

pc.expect: The post's shadow on the ground is unchanged by the ball passing through it.
pc.fail: The post's shadow bends or moves as the ball passes; or it vanishes; or it follows the ball.

pc.expect: The ball's own shadow continues on the ground on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: The ball has no shadow in sunlight; or its shadow lies toward the sun; or its shadow vanishes inside the post's shadow and does not return.

pc.expect: The ball rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves; or speeds up; or stops and restarts.

pc.expect: One ball, one post and its shadow.
pc.fail: A second ball appears; or the post vanishes; or the ball passes through the post; or a shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the pavement stay the same, and the shadows stay dark.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or a shadow turns coloured; or the pavement changes.
